name: Ṣàngó (Yoruba)

domain_history.domain: thunder and lightning, associated with fire and (in some sources) justice/retribution

notes: Historicization: Yorùbá oral-historical tradition (Samuel Johnson, The History of the Yorubas, completed 1897, published 1921) places Ṣàngó within the Òyó Aláàfin king-list, though sources disagree on his exact ordinal position (3rd vs. 4th Aláàfin) — report as "an early Aláàfin, ordinal position varies by source," not a fixed number. Sàngó in Africa and the African Diaspora (eds. Tishken, Falola, Akinyemi; Indiana UP, 2009) is explicitly organized around the mythic/historical/syncretic-diaspora split as an open scholarly question.
